name: ahip_t4_routine_indicators
title: Tool 4: High-Level Routine Indicators
description: Afya-Tek Phase III Baseline Assessment — Baseline Indicator Data Collection Tool. Reporting timeline: 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026.

item.text: How will you collect this interview?

valueCoding.display: Answer the questions on the phone

item.text: Purpose: collect actual baseline values for selected Phase III indicators from routine data sources for July 2025 - June 2026. Enter the actual number, numerator/denominator where applicable, and the verified baseline value.
District / council name (not in the list)

Record the interview below. If it is interrupted, record the rest as Part 2. Then write what the respondent said in the box under the recording. The questions on the next pages are optional when you record: answer any you can, then submit.
Summary of the recorded interview: write what the respondent said

Record values exactly as reported in the identified source. For rate/percentage indicators capture both numerator and denominator where available. For count indicators, enter the actual count and repeat the verified figure as the baseline value.
Adolescent pregnancy rate (percentage of women aged 10-19 years) in selected district councils — Unit: Percentage (%)
Numerator / actual number: No. of pregnancies among girls aged 10-19
Denominator: Relevant denominator used by source
Under-five mortality rate in selected district councils — Unit: Per 1,000 live births
Numerator / actual number: No. of deaths among children under five
Neonatal mortality rate in selected district council — Unit: Per 1,000 live births
Numerator / actual number: No. of neonatal deaths (0-28 days)
Maternal mortality rate in selected district councils — Unit: Per 100,000 live births
Numerator / actual number: No. of maternal deaths
Number of new tuberculosis cases occurring per 100,000 population per year — Unit: Per 100,000 population
Numerator / actual number: No. of newly identified TB cases
Number of TB cases recorded at health facilities — Unit: Number
Numerator / actual number: Actual number of TB cases
Number of TB cases at the health facilities referred by CHWs — Unit: Number
Numerator / actual number: Actual number of TB cases referred by CHWs
Number of mental health cases recorded at facilities — Unit: Number
Numerator / actual number: Actual number of mental health cases
Number of RoC referred by CHWs and receiving diabetes care at health facilities (Kibaha Municipal only) — Unit: Number
Numerator / actual number: Actual number of clients receiving diabetes care at the HF
Number of RoC referred by CHWs and receiving hypertension care at health facilities (Kibaha Municipal only) — Unit: Number
Numerator / actual number: Actual number of clients receiving hypertension care at the HF
Take a photo of the premises / facility (e.g. the signboard or the front of the building). Add a second photo if useful.
